summary.text: Sergio Esposito is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate for New York State Senate District 40 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Peter Harckham.
His campaign website describes him as a longtime Yorktown resident and former Yorktown councilman.

paragraphs.text: Esposito's campaign website says he has been a Yorktown resident for more than 30 years, grew a business there and served on the Yorktown town board.

It also describes him as a former president of the Yorktown Chamber of Commerce and lists lower taxes, safer communities, accountability in government and a business-friendly environment among his priorities.
